name: Volsung Cycle (Matter of the North)
note: Organizing hub for the Volsung/Nibelung legendary cycle, attested across Volsunga saga, the Poetic Edda heroic lays, and the Nibelungenlied.

name: Sigurd
note: The dragon-slayer (Old High German Siegfried), central hero of Volsunga saga who slays Fafnir and wins the cursed Andvari hoard; son of Sigmund. Sigurðr Fáfnisbani = Nibelungenlied's Siegfried.

name: Brynhild
note: Shieldmaiden/valkyrie betrothed to Sigurd; her betrayal via the Gjukungs drives the tragedy. Nibelungenlied's Brünhild.

name: Fafnir
note: Dwarf-turned-dragon who guards the cursed gold of Andvari; slain by Sigurd. Brother of Reginn.

name: Reginn
note: Smith and foster-father of Sigurd who reforges the sword Gram and incites the slaying of his brother Fafnir; later slain by Sigurd.

name: Sigmund
note: Son of Volsung, wielder of the sword drawn from Barnstokkr; father of Sigurd. Twin of Signy.

name: Signy
note: Daughter of Volsung, twin of Sigmund; engineers vengeance against Siggeir for the slaughter of her kin.

name: Volsung
note: Eponymous king and ancestor of the Volsung line, descendant of Odin; father of Sigmund and Signy.

name: Gunnar
note: Gjukung king, brother of Gudrun, who wins Brynhild through deceit and conspires in Sigurd's death. Nibelungenlied's Gunther.

name: Gudrun
note: Gjukung princess, wife of Sigurd; her grief and revenge drive the cycle's later tragedies. Nibelungenlied's Kriemhild.

name: Hogni
note: Gjukung brother of Gunnar and Gudrun, party to Sigurd's killing; dies defiantly in the hall of Atli. Nibelungenlied's Hagen.

name: Volundr (Wayland the Smith)
note: Legendary master smith (Old English Weland, German Wieland); his captivity and vengeance are told in the eddic Volundarkvida and Old English Deor/Franks Casket. Volundr = Old English Weland/Wayland = German Wieland; cross-attested beyond Byock in the Poetic Edda.

name: Starkadr
note: Multi-generational warrior-hero blessed and cursed by the gods; prominent in Saxo's Gesta Danorum and Gautreks saga.

name: Hervor
note: Shieldmaiden who claims the cursed sword Tyrfing from her father's barrow; central to Hervarar saga.

name: Ragnarr Lodbrok
note: Legendary Viking king and serpent-slayer; subject of Ragnars saga lodbrokar, loosely linked to the Volsung material through his wife Aslaug, daughter of Sigurd and Brynhild.
